content: Building Elixir/Phoenix Docker images for linux/arm64 via QEMU emulation on an amd64 CI runner can crash or run 5-20x slower due to Erlang JIT (OTP25+) vs QEMU JIT double-memory-mapping incompatibility; workaround is ERL_FLAGS=+JPperf true or building natively on arm64 runners. Multi-stage builds recommended; official elixir Docker image supports arm64v8 natively.
